Hey Joseph,
One final-final mechanics tweak that actually makes everything cleaner and simpler to code (no weird half-expiring tickets).
New rule (replaces the previous ticket lifespan description):
→ Every time someone mints with a referral code, the referrer instantly gets two separate tickets added to their NFT:
+1 Small Block Ticket
+1 Big Block Ticket

These are two completely independent counters.
Small Block ($2,500 pool → 5 × $500 draw):
Draw only from Small Block Tickets issued since the last small block.
After the draw, burn/reset all Small Block Tickets to 0.
Big Block ($100,000 pool → 5 × $20,000 draw):
Draw only from Big Block Tickets issued since the last big block.
After the draw, burn/reset all Big Block Tickets to 0.

This way:
Small blocks stay super fair and fresh (no one carries old tickets forward).
Big blocks naturally accumulate (people can see their big block entries climbing over weeks/months).
Metadata is trivial: just show the two counters + permanent badges.

Triggers stay pool-based (small block fires the moment small pool = exactly $2,500, big block when big pool = exactly $100,000). Secondary royalties still fill pools but don’t create tickets.
Everything else stays identical (auto $5 commission, random ticket to existing NFT when no ref used, manual claim, etc.).
This version should be easier to implement and explain to users.
Sorry for the flip-flop — Once you confirm this is cleaner for you too, we’re 100% locked.

Thanks man!

What is Project Rebuild?
Project Rebuild is my public mission to rebuild my family’s life after losing everything to a seed-phrase mistake.
I’m selling my novella memoir as an unlimited mint NFT ebook, on Base, using my first-of-its-kind FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model).
Readers can earn instant and unlimited commissions & prizes by sharing it. If the model proves itself, this becomes BooksOnChain — a community-owned platform for every indie creator.

How do buyers earn money?
1\. $5 instant commission every time someone mints with your referral code
2\. Small & Big Block prize tickets every time someone mints with your code
3\. Future BooksOnChain governance token (to buyers, affiliates, and tippers)

How do referrals work?
Every NFT’s mint number IS its permanent referral code.
Examples that both work perfectly:
→ Share your full link
→ Or just say “use referral 423”
When someone mints using your code → you instantly get $5 + Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.

Where do I find my referral code?
It’s your mint number. You’ll see it:
\- On-chain in your NFT metadata
\- On your Dashboard after minting
\- In your confirmation email (optional)

\### What are Small Block and Big Block prizes?
Small Block: 5 × $500 drawn every ~500 sales (mint + secondary)
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 drawn every ~50,000 sales (mint + secondary)
Pools funded from every sale forever.

\### How are winners selected?
Chainlink VRF — fully on-chain, provably fair, verifiable on Basescan.

\### What are Small & Big Block prize tickets?
One-time entries into the current Small Block and current Big Block draws.
You earn them only by getting people to mint with your code (1 Small + 1 Big per successful referral).
Once the block is drawn, those tickets expire and new referrals count toward the next blocks.

\### How do I claim my rewards?
\- $5 commissions → sent automatically to your wallet
\- Prize wins → announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click here on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz>

\### What are badges?
On-chain badges added to your NFT for hitting referral milestones (2, 10, 50, 100+).
Currently cosmetic + leaderboard flex. In the future they may unlock token-gated chats, discounts, airdrops, DAO weight, etc.

\### Can I mint with fiat (credit card)?
Yes — Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay. No crypto or wallet required.

\### Do I need a wallet to participate?
Only if you want affiliate commissions paid out or to trade the NFT later.

\### What blockchain is this on?
Base (Ethereum L2) — fast, cheap, Coinbase-backed.

\### Are there any hidden fees?
No. Mint = exactly $15. Secondary sales carry a visible $10 flat royalty.

\### What happens if I sell my NFT?
The buyer gets the book, your original mint number (now their referral code), and any badges you earned. Expired prize tickets stay expired.

\### How do I share my referral link/code?
Dashboard → copy full link or just copy your mint number and tell people “use referral 423”.

\### Is this a scam or pyramid scheme?
No. Single-level only. Unlimited supply. Full source verified on Basescan. I earn exactly $4 on every sale forever — same cut on mints and every secondary sale.

I answer personally and fast.

Still have questions? DM @ProjectRebuild on X or email will@projectrebuild.xyz — happy to help.

Page Title: About Project Rebuild
Sub-title: The first ebook launch that pays readers to spread it.

What is Project Rebuild?
Project Rebuild is the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — The first system that lets indie creators sell unlimited mint NFT ebooks and pay readers real commissions + prize tickets to share them.
Launching with my own raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal," on Base.
And is my public mission to rebuild my family's life after losing millions to a seed-phrase wipeout.

If our FAMM proves itself here, Project Rebuild evolves into BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform for every creator.

Built on Cutting-Edge Technology

\- Smart Contracts
Audited, secure Solidity on Base.
\- Chainlink VRF
Provably fair random selection for prize draws.
\- Aave Integration
Yield generation on prize pools via deposits.
\- Base Network
Low fees, fast transactions, Ethereum security.
\- Decentralized
Fully on-chain logic from day one, with initial V1 safeguards.
(evolving to full decentralization with battle-testing)

\- Secure
Industry leading protocols and best practices.

How It Works

Mint Your ebook NFT
Purchase your ebook NFT for $15 USD. Your mint number is your referral code.

Earn Through Referrals
Share your mint number or link. Instantly earn $5 USD every time someone mints using it. No limits, no expiration.
If no code is used → $5 + tickets go to a random existing ticket holder.

Accumulate Tickets
Each referral also gives you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.
More referrals = more tickets = better chances.

Win Prizes
Small Block: 5 × $500 every 500 sales.
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales.
(Sales = mint + secondary)
Winners selected randomly and fairly via Chainlink VRF.

Claim Your Rewards
Commissions sent automatically on-chain. Prizes announced on the Winners page — claim with one click whenever you're ready.

Key Features

Automatic Rewards: Smart contracts handle all payments instantly.
Fair Prize Selection: Chainlink VRF ensures true randomness.
Yield Generation: Prize pools earn yield through Aave integration.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards make it fun and competitive.
Transparency: All transactions and rules on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Built on Base for speed and minimal transaction costs.

Our Vision
Project Rebuild starts with one book, but this is only the beginning.
We envision a world where ebooks succeed on merit alone, free from the gatekeepers and Amazon algorithms drowning indie voices.
Where creators (unknown or established) rise because their work resonates, not because they game a platform, have the connections or buy enough ads.
Where fans get paid for the word-of-mouth marketing they've always done for free, and where any hustler can jump in to earn if they spot a gem worth spreading.

Our goal: a self-sustaining model that benefits everyone.
Artists earn their fair share, fans & affiliates build real income, communities forge direct bonds — transforming one underdog's recovery into a decentralized revolution for all creators.
All without hype, just aligned incentives.

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?":

If you're buying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and new to crypto, don't worry — the process is designed to be simple. When you mint the book for $15 via Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically created for you behind the scenes (no seed phrase needed). This wallet holds your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes.

Here's how it works step by step:
During the Purchase:
Transak handles the fiat-to-crypto conversion and mints the NFT directly to a new wallet address for you.
You don't need to set up anything manually — it's seamless and non-custodial (you own the keys, but no complicated seed phrase to manage right away).
You'll get an email confirmation with your mint number (your referral code), NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz>.

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Share your referral code (e.g., "use 8421"). When someone mints with it, $5 is automatically sent to your wallet address.
To collect: Log into your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz> (using the email link or SIWE with the wallet Transak created). Your commissions appear there instantly — no action needed. If needed, we'll guide you on exporting to a bank account or exchange (e.g., via Coinbase).

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $500/$10,000 Draws):
Each referral gives you tickets for the current prize draws. These are tied to your NFT/wallet automatically.
Draws happen on-chain (every ~100 sales for $500, ~10,000 for $10,000) via fair randomness.
Winners are announced on the Winners page and emailed to you.

To collect a prize: If you win, the amount ($500 or $10,000) is sent straight to your wallet.
Check your dashboard/email for notifications
